units.text: 2. A federal law, the constitution (charter) or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or the municipal charter may determine matters that must be submitted to a local referendum.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 43

units.text: 3. A local referendum is held throughout the territory of the municipality.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 43

units.text: 4. A decision to call a local referendum is adopted by the municipal representative body:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 43

units.text: 1) at the initiative of citizens of the Russian Federation entitled to participate in the local referendum;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 43

units.text: 2) at the initiative of electoral associations or other public associations whose charters provide for participation in elections and/or referendums and which are registered in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by federal law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 43

units.text: 3) at the joint initiative of the municipal representative body and the head of the local administration.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 43

units.text: 5. Calling a local referendum at the initiative of citizens, electoral associations or other public associations referred to in point 2 of part 4 of this Article requires the collection of signatures in support of the initiative. The number of signatures is established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and may not exceed 5 percent of the number of referendum participants registered in the municipality in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 43

units.text: 6. A referendum initiative proposed by citizens, electoral associations or other public associations referred to in point 2 of part 4 of this Article is formalized in accordance with the procedure established by federal law and a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 43

units.text: 7. A referendum initiative proposed jointly by the municipal representative body and the head of the local administration is formalized by legal acts of the representative body and the head of the local administration.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 43

units.text: 8. The municipal representative body must call a local referendum within 30 days after receiving the documents on the basis of which the referendum is to be called.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 43

units.text: 9. If the municipal representative body fails to call a local referendum within the established time limits, the referendum is called by a court upon an application by citizens, electoral associations, the head of the municipality, state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a prosecutor. A local referendum called by a court is organized by the relevant referendum commission, and support for its conduct is provided by an executive body of the constituent entity or another body designated by the court to ensure the conduct of the referendum.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 43

units.text: 10. Citizens of the Russian Federation whose place of residence is within the municipality’s boundaries have the right to participate in a local referendum. Citizens of the Russian Federation participate in a local referendum on the basis of universal, equal and direct expression of will by secret ballot.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 43

units.text: 11. The voting results and the decision adopted at a local referendum must be officially published.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 43

units.text: 12. A decision adopted at a local referendum is binding throughout the municipality and does not require approval by any public authorities or their officials.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 43

units.text: 13. Local self-government bodies ensure implementation of the decision adopted at a local referendum in accordance with the division of powers among them determined by the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 43

units.text: 14. A decision to hold a local referendum and a decision adopted at a local referendum may be challenged in court by citizens, local self-government bodies, a prosecutor or state authorities authorized by federal law.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 43

units.text: 15. Guarantees of citizens’ rights to participate in a local referendum and the procedure for preparing and conducting it are established by federal law and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 43

units.text: Article 44. Municipal elections
units.label: Art. 44

units.text: 1. Municipal elections are held to elect deputies, the head of the municipality and other persons holding municipal offices in accordance with the municipal charter, on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44

units.text: 2. Municipal elections are called by the municipal representative body within the time limits provided for by the municipal charter. In the cases established by federal law, municipal elections are called by the relevant election commission or a court.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 44

units.text: 3. Guarantees of citizens’ electoral rights in municipal elections and the procedure for calling, preparing and conducting municipal elections, establishing vote totals and determining election results are established by federal law and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 44

units.text: 4. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws, establishes the types of electoral systems that may be used in municipal elections and the procedure for their use.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 44

units.text: 5. In accordance with the types of electoral systems established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the municipal charter determines the electoral system used in municipal elections in that municipality. In this Article, an electoral system means the conditions for recognizing a candidate or candidates as elected, admitting lists of candidates to the allocation of deputy mandates, and the procedure for allocating mandates among lists of candidates and within those lists.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 44

units.text: 6. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may, in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws, determine the conditions for using types of electoral systems in municipalities depending on the number of voters, the type of municipality and other circumstances.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 44

units.text: 7. Elections of deputies of representative bodies of urban okrugs and municipal okrugs having fewer than 15 deputies are held in single-member and/or multi-member constituencies.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 44

units.text: 8. If, in a municipal representative body elected in municipal elections, some deputy mandates are distributed under electoral legislation among lists of candidates nominated by political parties (their regional branches or other structural subdivisions) in proportion to the number of votes received by each list, at least 10 deputy mandates must be distributed among those lists.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 44

units.text: 9. The results of municipal elections must be officially published.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 44

units.text: Article 45. Citizens’ assembly
units.label: Art. 45

units.text: 1. In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, a citizens’ assembly may be held:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 45

units.text: 1) in a settlement forming part of the municipality’s territory, on introducing and using citizens’ self-taxation funds in that settlement;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 45

units.text: 2) in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in part of the territory of a settlement forming part of the municipality’s territory, on introducing and using citizens’ self-taxation funds in that part of the settlement;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 45

units.text: 3) throughout the municipality or in part of its territory, to ascertain citizens’ opinions on support for an initiative project.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 45

units.text: 2. In the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on municipal service, a citizens’ assembly may be held in a rural settlement to nominate candidates for a competition commission when a competition to fill a municipal service position is held.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 45

units.text: 3. A citizens’ assembly may be convened by the head of the municipality or by the municipal representative body, including at the initiative of a group of at least 10 residents of the relevant part of the settlement.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 45

units.text: 4. The head of the municipality ensures that the citizens’ assembly is held.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 45

units.text: 5. The procedure for organizing and holding a citizens’ assembly is determined by the municipal charter and must provide for advance notification of municipal residents of the assembly’s time and place, advance access to the draft municipal legal act and materials on matters submitted for decision by the assembly, and other measures ensuring municipal residents’ participation in the assembly.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 45

units.text: 6. The criteria for determining the boundaries of a part of a settlement within the municipality where a citizens’ assembly may be held on introducing and using citizens’ self-taxation funds are established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 45

units.text: 7. A citizens’ assembly is quorate if more than half of the residents of the settlement (or part of its territory) who have voting rights participate.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 45

units.text: 8. If a settlement cannot accommodate the simultaneous joint presence of more than half of its residents who have voting rights, the citizens’ assembly is held in stages in accordance with the charter of the municipality that includes the settlement, within a period not exceeding one month after the decision to hold the assembly. Persons who have already participated in the assembly do not take part in voting at subsequent stages.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 45

units.text: 9. A decision of a citizens’ assembly is considered adopted if more than half of the assembly’s participants vote in favor.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 45

units.text: 10. Local self-government bodies and officials ensure implementation of decisions adopted at a citizens’ assembly in accordance with the division of powers among them determined by the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 45

units.text: 11. Decisions adopted at a citizens’ assembly must be officially published.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 45

units.text: Article 46. Survey
units.label: Art. 46

units.text: 1. A citizens’ survey may be conducted throughout a municipality or in part of its territory to ascertain public opinion when local self-government bodies and officials take decisions in exercising powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, and when state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation take decisions in exercising powers concerning the establishment of general principles for the organization of local self-government.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 46

units.text: 2. Residents of the municipality who have voting rights are entitled to participate in a citizens’ survey.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 46

units.text: 3. Residents aged eighteen or over of the municipality or part of it in which an initiative project is proposed to be implemented may participate in a survey to ascertain citizens’ opinions on support for that initiative project.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 46

units.text: 4. A citizens’ survey is conducted at the initiative of:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 46

units.text: 1) the municipal representative body, the head of the municipality or the head of the local administration;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 46

units.text: 2) state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 46

units.text: 3) residents of the municipality or part of it in which an initiative project is proposed to be implemented, to ascertain citizens’ opinions on support for that initiative project.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 46

units.text: 5. The procedure for calling and conducting a citizens’ survey is determined by regulatory legal acts of the municipal representative body in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 46

units.text: 6. The municipal representative body must decide to call a citizens’ survey within three months after receipt of a survey initiative provided for in part 4 of this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 46

units.text: 7. The decision of the municipal representative body to call a citizens’ survey establishes:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 1) the date and duration of the survey;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 2) the wording of the question or questions put in the survey;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 3) the survey methodology;
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 4) the questionnaire form;
units.label: Point 4 Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 5) the minimum number of municipal residents participating in the survey;
units.label: Point 5 Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 6) the procedure for identifying survey participants if the survey is conducted using the municipality’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network.
units.label: Point 6 Part 7 Art. 46

units.text: 8. Municipal residents must be informed of the citizens’ survey by the authorized local self-government body or official at least 10 days before it is conducted.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 46

units.text: 9. The municipality’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network may be used to conduct a citizens’ survey.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 46

units.text: 10. Activities related to preparing and conducting a citizens’ survey are financed:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 46

units.text: 1) from the local budget where the survey is conducted at the initiative of local self-government bodies or municipal residents;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 46

units.text: 2) from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation where the survey is conducted at the initiative of state authorities of that constituent entity.
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 46
